ENGINE MAPPING
- ALPHA: Creation / architecture
- BETA: Validation / QA / compliance
- GAMMA: Intelligence / analytics
- DELTA: Execution / build / deployment
- THETA: Optimization / efficiency
- BRAVO: Business / sales / CRM
- OMEGA: Governance / evidence / audit

FINAL RELEASE INVARIANT
TECHNICAL_GREEN ∧ SECURITY_GREEN ∧ EVIDENCE_GREEN ∧ AUDIT_GREEN
Financial/business claims remain separate and require independent Track-B evidence.
